query: I have a 30 second reference teaser at ~/refs/teaser.mov and want to clone its rhythm for my app. Where do we start?
expected_behavior: Keeps the reference file outside the repository
Builds or asks for a shot map with timecodes before writing any scene code
Works one scene at a time and does not render the whole film to iterate
Plans a side-by-side proof bundle for the first scene

query: I only changed the score. Re-render and send me the new version.
expected_behavior: Re-muxes the new score into the existing previews without rendering any frame
Rebuilds the proof bundle from what is already rendered
Does not start a full-film render

query: Make the 9:16 version of the finished 16:9 film.
expected_behavior: Re-blocks the stage through windows instead of a plain crop or black bands
Redraws wide content such as a chat in portrait proportions
Keeps picture events and the score identical to the master
Checks a contact sheet of the whole decline before delivering

query: Add the side-by-side with the reference to our README and post it on social media.
expected_behavior: Declines to commit or publish the pair because it carries third-party picture and sound
Proposes publishing our own cut with our own score instead
Mentions checking repository visibility, the reference's licence and each platform's AI disclosure

query: The brand sent its logo kit. Put the logo on the end card.
expected_behavior: Uses the supplied file or path instead of redrawing the mark by hand
Keeps the flat brand colour with no shadow, outline, glow or gradient
Respects the protection zone and checks the mark at 100 percent in every format
